recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. It completes FHIR-34375 without changing cardinality or binding strength; handle the later THO migration separately under FHIR-55302/FHIR-55309 when those resolved-change-required issues are ready for application.
issue_request: FHIR-34375 was an Applied/Persuasive PA change request for Practitioner to add a codified registration/license status under Practitioner.qualification, with a preferred binding to a new qualification-status value set, explicit period interpretation guidance for inactive-style statuses, and Organization qualification consideration.
initial_application: The explicit source application in 8a72f002f103699cbac8522fbdddadb120b4812f added Practitioner.qualification.status, Organization.qualification.status, the qualification-status CodeSystem, and the qualification-status ValueSet. The follow-up 16b7d8a91a8357943f8e39bcb52b8ee768fb8b85 added standards-status metadata. Before this reconciliation, the period comment from the Jira resolution was still missing and Practitioner.qualification.status contained a broken phrase, "and m be related".
additional_context: Practitioner and Organization are active core resources in source/fhir.ini, so their StructureDefinition XML files are current build inputs. PA September 2023 minutes reference FHIR-34375 and support the persuasive/preferred-binding disposition. Later FHIR-55302 and FHIR-55309 propose moving qualification-status terminology to THO, but those issues remain Resolved - change required and do not supersede the current core source obligation for this Applied/Published reconciliation run.
reconciliation: Added the inactive qualification status period interpretation comment to Practitioner.qualification.period and Organization.qualification.period, preserving identical semantics for the shared qualification-status binding. Also corrected Practitioner.qualification.status so its short text and revoked/cancelled period sentence match the intended and Organization wording.
source_changes: source/practitioner/structuredefinition-Practitioner.xml: corrected Practitioner.qualification.status short/definition wording and added the inactive-status period interpretation comment to Practitioner.qualification.period.

source/organization/structuredefinition-Organization.xml: added the same inactive-status period interpretation comment to Organization.qualification.period for consistency with the shared qualification-status binding.
